nativeToWorld.meaning: Signed native local Y is preserved. Deepest plate maps to world h=0; native surface maps to world h=46.64. This is artist binding metadata, not a general terrain/basement implementation.

targetWorld.use: Height/datum reference only. Custom geometry is not encoded as guessed axis-aligned solids.

integration.legacyExport: reject: curved walls, clipped floors, above-six-level height and moving geometry cannot be preserved by legacy map/block data
